why: An exfoliating scrub uses fine abrasive material to loosen dead surface cells. It also helps smooth dry, flaky skin and reduce calluses.
exfoliating scrub（去角质磨砂膏）利用细小磨料松动表面死亡细胞，还能帮助平滑干燥脱屑皮肤并减轻老茧。
lock: scrub = mechanical removal of dead surface skin.
磨砂膏 = 机械去除表面死亡皮肤。

why: Diabetes can reduce circulation and healing, so even a small cut may become serious. Never cut living eponychium tissue.
diabetes（糖尿病）可能降低血液循环和愈合能力，因此小伤口也可能变严重。绝不能剪切活体甲上皮组织。
lock: diabetes + living skin = avoid injury.
糖尿病客户的活体皮肤 = 避免造成损伤。

why: Massage is the manual manipulation of soft body tissues. Rubbing, kneading, pinching, and tapping are movements used to produce relaxation.
massage（按摩）是用手对身体软组织进行操作；揉擦、揉捏、捏压和叩击等动作可帮助放松。
lock: massage = manual tissue manipulation.
massage = 用手操作软组织。

why: Petrissage lifts, squeezes, and presses soft tissue. On the foot, this kneading movement can relax tissue without rapid tapping.
petrissage（揉捏法）会提起、挤压并按压软组织；在足部，这种揉捏动作可使组织放松，不使用快速叩击。
lock: petrissage = lift, squeeze, and press tissue.
petrissage = 提起、挤压并按压组织。

why: Acetone is a solvent that softens many soak-off enhancement products. Product can then be removed gently without prying it from the nail.
acetone（丙酮）是一种能软化多种可卸式美甲增强材料的溶剂，使产品可被轻柔去除，无需从指甲上撬下。
lock: acetone = solvent for soak-off removal.
acetone = 用于浸泡卸除的溶剂。
refs: Monomer Liquid and Polymer Powder Nail Enhancements - Product Removal

why: Red, swollen tissue may indicate infection or serious irritation. Do not diagnose or service the area; explain the concern and refer the client.
组织发红、肿胀可能表示感染或严重刺激。不要诊断或护理该部位，应说明问题并转介客户就医。
lock: redness and swelling = stop and refer.
发红和肿胀 = 停止服务并转介。
refs: Nail Structure, Disorders, and Diseases - Diseases of the Nail

why: Massage lotion reduces drag between the hands and skin. Controlled glide helps the practitioner apply smooth pressure without pulling dry tissue.
按摩乳液可减少双手与皮肤之间的摩擦，使从业者能够平稳施压，不会拉扯干燥组织。
lock: massage lotion = smooth glide with less drag.
按摩乳液 = 顺滑移动并减少摩擦。

why: A nail buffer uses a fine abrasive to smooth minor surface ridges and create shine. Excess pressure can thin or heat the plate.
nail buffer（抛光棒）利用细磨料平滑轻微表面纹路并增加光泽；压力过大会使甲板变薄或发热。
lock: buffer = smooth and shine, using light pressure.
抛光棒 = 轻压平滑并增加光泽。

why: Gel photoinitiators absorb ultraviolet energy and start curing. The lamp must match the gel system so the product hardens fully.
凝胶中的 photoinitiator（光引发剂）吸收紫外线能量后启动固化；灯具必须与凝胶系统匹配，产品才能完全硬化。
lock: gel cures when photoinitiator absorbs UV energy.
凝胶固化 = 光引发剂吸收紫外线能量。
refs: Light-Cured Gels - Gel Chemistry and Curing

why: Soft gel has a structure that acetone can penetrate and break down. Hard gel must usually be filed off instead of soaked off.
soft gel（软凝胶）的结构可让丙酮渗透并分解；hard gel（硬凝胶）通常需要磨除，不能浸泡卸除。
lock: soft gel = soak off; hard gel = file off.
soft gel = 浸泡卸除；hard gel = 磨除。
refs: Light-Cured Gels - Soft and Hard Gels

why: Oil, moisture, or cuticle left on the plate blocks product contact. Careful cleaning and drying create the surface needed for strong attachment.
甲板上残留的油、水分或甲小皮会阻碍产品接触。仔细清洁并擦干，才能形成牢固附着所需的表面。
lock: prevent lifting: prepare a clean, dry nail plate.
防止起翘：把甲板处理得清洁、干燥。
refs: Nail Product Chemistry - Adhesion of Nail Enhancements

why: Cuticle remover softens and dissolves dead tissue attached to the nail plate. It must stay off living skin and be removed on time.
cuticle remover（甲小皮软化剂）会软化并溶解附着在甲板上的死亡组织，必须避开活体皮肤并按时清除。
lock: cuticle remover dissolves dead tissue on the plate.
甲小皮软化剂溶解甲板上的死亡组织。

why: Most abrasive files are porous and cannot be disinfected completely. Use a new file for each client, then discard it.
多数指甲锉具有多孔性，无法彻底消毒。每位客户使用新锉，服务后将其丢弃。
lock: porous abrasive file = one client, one use.
多孔指甲锉 = 一位客户，一次使用。

why: A catalyst speeds the curing reaction by activating initiators. It helps control how quickly the enhancement hardens after liquid and powder combine.
catalyst（催化剂）通过激活引发剂来加快固化反应，帮助控制液体与粉末混合后增强材料的硬化速度。
lock: catalyst controls curing speed.
catalyst 控制固化速度。
refs: Monomer Liquid and Polymer Powder Nail Enhancements - Catalysts and Initiators

why: A finger bowl holds warm soapy water that cleans and softens the nails and surrounding skin. Soaking time should remain brief.
finger bowl（浸手碗）盛放温肥皂水，用于清洁并软化指甲及周围皮肤；浸泡时间应保持简短。
lock: finger bowl = brief cleansing and softening soak.
浸手碗 = 短时间清洁和软化浸泡。

why: A medium-grit abrasive shapes the free edge with control. Coarse abrasives can remove too much material and damage a natural nail.
中等砂砾度指甲锉可受控地塑造游离缘；粗砂锉可能去除过多材料并损伤天然指甲。
lock: natural nail shaping = medium grit, gentle pressure.
天然指甲塑形 = 中等砂砾度，轻柔用力。
refs: Manicuring - Abrasive Nail Files and Grit

why: Acetone is a widely used salon solvent that dissolves many nail coatings. Safe use still requires fresh air, closed containers, and skin protection.
acetone（丙酮）是沙龙常用的溶剂，可溶解多种指甲涂层；安全使用仍需保持空气流通、密闭容器并保护皮肤。
lock: acetone = common nail-product solvent.
acetone = 常见的美甲产品溶剂。

why: Monomer liquid reacts with polymer powder during curing. Catalysts and initiators control the chain reaction that turns the mixture into a solid enhancement.
monomer liquid（单体液）在固化时与聚合物粉反应；催化剂和引发剂控制链式反应，使混合物变成固体增强材料。
lock: liquid-and-powder system begins with monomer liquid.
液体与粉末系统以 monomer liquid 为液体成分。
refs: Monomer Liquid and Polymer Powder Nail Enhancements - Chemistry

why: A foot file smooths thick callused skin with controlled abrasion. Use light pressure and never file living or broken skin.
foot file（足部锉）通过受控磨削平滑厚老茧。应轻柔用力，绝不能磨活体或破损皮肤。
lock: foot file = smooth callus, not living skin.
足部锉 = 平滑老茧，不磨活体皮肤。

why: Thorough handwashing uses soap, friction, rinsing, and complete drying to remove germs after a service and before touching clean supplies.
彻底洗手需要使用肥皂、摩擦、冲洗并完全擦干，以清除服务后的微生物，再接触清洁用品。
lock: handwashing = soap, friction, rinse, and dry.
洗手 = 肥皂、摩擦、冲洗、擦干。
refs: Milady Standard Foundations - Infection Control - Hand Washing
